summary.title: Summary
summary.paragraph1: For me, programming is an opportunity to create something new, find joy in solving complex problems, work in a team with cool people, and see my skills rewarded with a decent income.

provision_monitoring.title: Provision Monitoring Application
provision_monitoring.description: Provision 360 is an intelligent monitoring system for construction sites developed by Mindset. It combines computer vision, 360° photography, and BIM modeling technologies for automatic construction progress control and increased process transparency.

threejsTour1.title: Interactive 3D Tours (Three.js).
threejsTour1.description: Provision 360 3D tours are virtual excursions of construction sites, combining 360° panoramic photos, 3D models obtained through laser scanning, and interactive control tools. A handy tool for training, admissions and presentations.

image_to_text.title: Image To Text
